summary: Implementation satisfies the contract. POST /todos returns 201 with all required fields, GET /todos returns items in creation order. TodoStore is scoped per app instance for test isolation. Build and all 9 tests pass. Commit is a single clean feature-scoped commit touching only the 3 expected files.
findings: TodoStore injected via factory function (createTodosRouter) — good dependency inversion and test isolation.
GET /todos relies on Map insertion order for creation-order guarantee, which is correct per ES2015+ spec.
Tests use separate createApp() calls ensuring no state leakage between test cases.
